package shop

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenRename(t *testing.T) {
	c := Cart{Items: []Item{{SKU: "a", Price: 250, Qty: 2}, {SKU: "b", Price: 99, Qty: 1}}}
	if got := c.Subtotal(); got != 599 {
		t.Fatalf("Subtotal = %d", got)
	}
	if got := c.DiscountedTotal(10); got != 540 {
		t.Fatalf("DiscountedTotal = %d", got)
	}
	if _, still := reflect.TypeOf(Cart{}).MethodByName("CalcTotal"); still {
		t.Fatal("CalcTotal still exists")
	}
}
